nl: 商品分类管理：查询分类名称；表格展示分类名称、排序号；分类是树形结构，子分类放在 subItems 字段里（不是默认的 children）；支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Product category management: query by category name; the table shows category name and sort order; categories are hierarchical with children under the subItems field (not the default children); supports add, edit and delete.
notes: AI-09 子项③: 自定义子节点键名 childrenField=subItems（vue3/schema）
